label: Colloquial function words in personal prose
explanation: It fires only inside informal, first-/second-person writing — advice, personal blogs, casual narratives with contractions and direct address — landing on "glue" tokens: prepositions (to, with, for, of, by), complementizers/conjunctions (that, if, what, than, or), infinitive verbs after "to", and verbs after "you/I". It fires strongest in the most colloquial passages (profanity, exhortation, "talk to"/"going with"-type verb constructions) and fades to weak spillover in neutral third-person or boilerplate text; it stays silent in formal prose and on articles and locative prepositions like in/on/at.
